query: Roughly how many years older is the Great Pyramid of Giza than the Colosseum?
answer:
The Great Pyramid is about 2,600 years older than the Colosseum, so the gap is roughly 2,650 years. The Great Pyramid was built for the pharaoh Khufu, and sources date its completion to around 2580–2560 BC, though some estimates are a little later [1][2][3]. The Colosseum was started under Vespasian around 70–72 AD and finished under Titus in 80 AD [4]. Because there is no year 0, 2560 BC to 80 AD works out to about 2,640 years, and 2580 BC gives about 2,660. In other words, when the Colosseum opened, the Great Pyramid was already older than the Colosseum is now (about 1,950 years).

Sources:
[1] https://worldhistory.org/timeline/architecture – World History Encyclopedia, Architecture Timeline
[2] https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/26th_century_BC_in_architecture – 26th century BC in architecture (Wikipedia)
[3] https://britannica.com/place/Great-Pyramid-of-Giza – Great Pyramid of Giza (Britannica)
